dedupe_keys.name: sulcis iglesiente guspinese industrial remediation boundaries 2011

description: The Autonomous Region of Sardinia publishes boundaries for the Sulcis-Iglesiante-Guspinese nationally designated remediation site. Five related 2011 map layers identify mining areas, industrial areas, the SIN landfill, marine areas and areas under ministry responsibility. The source describes these as contaminated areas associated with historical industrial activity and subject to a national remediation procedure. Information was recovered from provincial databases and paper archives. The layers describe the spatial extent and administrative responsibility of this specific industrial site; they do not establish operating status, contamination concentrations, remediation progress or engineering performance. Shapefile and map-service routes are listed in the native metadata. The five layers form one source-defined remediation site and may overlap, so they are retained as complementary components. Specific simulation uses are not established in the inspected metadata. Reuse fields name CC BY 4.0 but also contain a conflicting CC BY 2.5 Italy statement linked to a Piemonte water-network document. Both statements are preserved; the exact applicable licence version remains unresolved. Public-access limitations are stated as absent. Metadata dates are from 2020 and do not change the 2011 layer labels. No map, dataset or linked document body was read.
